Gamma family random values

Source: R/random.R
random_gamma.Rd

Ports of jax.random.gamma, loggamma, beta, dirichlet, chisquare, f and t. The exact samplers are rejection samplers (Marsaglia and Tsang); their gradients with respect to the shape parameters use implicit reparameterization through lax_random_gamma_grad(). random_random_gamma_p is the underlying primitive.

Usage

random_gamma(
  key,
  a,
  shape = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  method = "exact",
  out_sharding = NULL
)

random_loggamma(
  key,
  a,
  shape = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  method = "exact",
  out_sharding = NULL
)

random_random_gamma_p

random_beta(
  key,
  a,
  b,
  shape = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  method = "exact",
  out_sharding = NULL
)

random_dirichlet(key, alpha, shape = NULL, dtype = NULL, out_sharding = NULL)

random_chisquare(
  key,
  df,
  shape = NULL,
  dtype = NULL,
  method = "exact",
  out_sharding = NULL
)

random_f(key, dfnum, dfden, shape = NULL, dtype = NULL, out_sharding = NULL)

random_t(key, df, shape = NULL, dtype = NULL, out_sharding = NULL)

Arguments

key

A PRNG key from random_key() or random_PRNGKey().

a, b

Shape parameters (a for gamma, a and b for beta).

shape

Integer vector; NULL broadcasts the parameters.

dtype

A float dtype.

method

"exact" (rejection sampler) or "approximate" (loop free, slightly biased).

out_sharding

Ignored (one device).

alpha

Dirichlet concentration of shape (..., n).

df

Degrees of freedom.

dfnum, dfden

Numerator and denominator degrees of freedom.

Value

An array.
